page_title: SHU 1-3 NOT | Sheffield Utd v Nottingham Forest 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) replaces Chris Wood.
90' Nuno Espirito Santo decides to make a substitution. Callum Hudson-Odoi will be replaced by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham).
87' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
86' The current number of shots on goal is 5:4.
83' Gonzalo Montiel comes off the pitch to be replaced by Harry Toffolo (Nottingham).

82' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
79' Nottingham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
78' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul.
75' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) for his blatant foul.
74' Chris Wilder has decided to make a change. Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) replaces Cameron Archer.
74' Danilo (Nottingham) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
69' Nottingham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
67' Nuno Espirito Santo prepares a substitution. Anthony Elanga is replaced by Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham).
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) comes onto the pitch so that Andre Brooks can be given a rest.

66' 1 - 3 Goal! Morgan Gibbs-White displays great vision and sends a pass to Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the right post. The score is 1:3.

62' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
61' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Matz Sels is alert and denies him.
60' Sheffield Utd control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

58' Ambitious effort from Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.

56' Fine attempt! Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
52' 1 - 2 Goal! Ryan Yates (Nottingham) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 1:2.

50' That's unlucky! Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
49' Nottingham are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' The end of the first half.

45+5' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) latched on to a good low pass and attempted to surprise the goalkeeper with a snap shot, but the ball skewed off his foot flew well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
44' Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
43' Nottingham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
42' Chris Wood (Nottingham) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the crossbar!
42' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
41' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
39' Sheffield Utd will take a corner kick.

38' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Matz Sels makes a great save to stop the effort going into the right side of the goal. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sheffield Utd.
37' Sheffield Utd have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
35' Sheffield Utd failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

35' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Sheffield Utd have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

34' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
34' Sheffield Utd take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
33' The resulting set piece from Sheffield Utd is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

33' Willy Boly (Nottingham) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nottingham.
30' Danilo (Nottingham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Sheffield Utd.
27' 1 - 1 Goal! Danilo slips it to Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) on the edge of the box and he finds the top right corner with a great effort. The score is 1:1.

26' Danilo (Nottingham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.

25' That's unlucky! Danilo (Nottingham) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The ball is out of play and Nottingham manage to earn a corner.
23' Matz Sels (Nottingham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
20' Matz Sels (Nottingham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
17' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) into the top left hand corner, giving goalkeeper Matz Sels no chance!
17' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) is going to take the penalty!
16' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

16' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham). Chris Kavanagh saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. PENALTY to Sheffield Utd! Let's see who will take responsibility.
13' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
12' The game is interrupted now, Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
11' Great teamplay by Nottingham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
8' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
4' The ball is cleared after Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

2' Chris Wood (Nottingham) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Sheffield Utd will take the kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh is the one to supervise the game today.
